_comment: Sources for the agent-specified relocation experiment, frozen 2026-11-05 before any composite or edit existed. Selection evidence and the rejection of 0_tr48 are in DECISIONS.md D3.
_tracks: Worker tracks are read from measurements written by earlier GPU jobs. No detector runs in the annotation stage.

sources.selection_reason: Source of all four earlier attempts, so a result is directly comparable with four recorded negatives. Worker fully inside the frame with feet near row 297, the best case for segmenting a whole body. 49 of 49 frames detected.
Camera view A, which no LoRA training footage came from. Worker closest to the lane of the three at 262.4 px median, so the shortest plausible transition. Zero detector misses.
Hardest case: worker farthest from the lane at 394.6 px median, with the largest and clearest lane marking at 13537 px. Different recording from 0_tr143 despite sharing camera view B.

rejected.reason: The detector misses the worker in 24 of 49 source frames. A method that cuts out a worker and moves him cannot run on footage where he is located in half the frames: the masks would have 24 holes and any failure would be unattributable. Rejected for tracking quality, not for its result.

Already recorded in outputs/multi_walkway/selection_record.json: its worker is on the marked lane for essentially the whole clip at 0.4 px median despite the class-0 label. There is no violation to relocate.
